Lassen Sie sich von der winterlichen Atm: Let the winter atmosphere enchant you and enjoy the Advent brunch on board our boat. On a scenic scheduled trip, a generous brunch buffet awaits with everything you could wish for: homemade rösti, fine cheese and meat specialities, and Bircher muesli. Perfect for a relaxing break in the run-up to Christmas.
An Bord sorgt das Trio «Guido Frei» mit: On board, the trio «Guido Frei» sets the mood with Swiss accordion and double bass. Enjoy a hearty farmer's brunch with rösti, fried bacon and egg, sausages, cheese and much more.
An Bord sorgen die Bielersee Buebe mit S: On board, the Bielersee Buebe set the mood with Swiss accordion and double bass. Enjoy a hearty farmer's brunch with braided bread, fried bacon, sausages, cheese and much more.
Unser Gastroteam verwöhnt Sie mit einer: Our catering team serves a chateaubriand platter with potato gratin and a selection of vegetables. A house salad with our own dressing comes first as a starter.
Geniessen Sie in geselliger Atmosphäre e: Enjoy a cheese fondue with bread, potatoes, fruit and pickled vegetables in a convivial atmosphere. The view of the Aare's banks makes the trip a memorable experience. The fondue trip can also be booked as a private boat.
Erleben Sie eine traditionelle Metzgete: Experience a traditional Metzgete in a rather different setting, on the boat. Our on-board kitchen serves the classic meat dishes with a choice of sides, while you enjoy the view of the autumn shores.
Während einer entspannten Fahrt auf der: On a relaxed trip along the Aare, our on-board kitchen serves a delicious three-course menu. Let it take you to Central America and enjoy a taste of Mexico.
Freuen Sie sich auf eine genussvolle Rei: Look forward to a culinary journey to Central America on a leisurely trip across Lake Biel. Our on-board kitchen serves a delicious three-course Mexican menu.
Feiern Sie Ostern auf einer entspannten: Celebrate Easter on a relaxed trip along the Aare with a fine Easter brunch: fried egg, bacon, the captain's honey, cheese and much more.
Celebrate Easter on a relaxed round trip on Lake Biel with a fine Easter brunch: fried egg, bacon, the captain's honey, cheese and much more.
Raclette und Winter gehören zusammen. Au: Raclette and winter belong together, and raclette tastes especially good on a boat. A mixed salad, potatoes and other sides are on offer. You can add a mixed meat platter with air-dried beef, raw ham, bacon and smoked sausage. The raclette trip can also be booked as a private boat.

Wir haben Glück – auf dem Weg durch die: On his way through Switzerland, Samichlaus (St Nicholas) has swapped his reindeer sleigh for the boat and brought plenty of sweets. Children who already know their little rhyme can recite it to him, and he rewards them with sweets.
In den Reben oberhalb von Ligerz und mit: The two well-known churches on the left shore of Lake Biel, in the vineyards above Ligerz and in the middle of Twann, catch the eye on every trip and are landmarks of the region. The Reformed parish Pilgerweg Bielersee, to which they belong, and the Catholic church of Lyss-Seeland invite you to a church service on the lake.
Geniessen Sie zum Jahresabschluss eine C: End the year with a chateaubriand platter on board, then welcome the new year with a glass of sparkling wine at midnight in the chalet of the Restaurant Joran.
Lassen Sie das Jahr bei einem köstlichen: See the year out with a fondue chinoise on the boat, then welcome the new year with a glass of sparkling wine at midnight in the chalet of the Restaurant Joran.
Lassen Sie die Korken auf dem Schiff kna: Pop the corks on the boat and celebrate the start of 2027. A DJ plays the music on board, and our catering team serves a five-course menu.
Geniessen Sie zum Jahresabschluss ein fe: End the year with a festive menu on board, then welcome the new year with a glass of sparkling wine at midnight at the boat landing in Solothurn.
Die Profis vom Spielladen «Delirium Lude: The experts from the Biel game shop «Delirium Ludens» bring new and well-known board games on board. Try different games on your own or have them explained to you. The game boat is suitable for players aged 8 and up.
Die original Twanner Treberwurst ist ein: The original Twann Treberwurst is a local speciality of the Lake Biel wine region. It comes with a potato and leek gratin, and a dessert to finish. We are happy to recommend a local wine to go with it.

Überraschen Sie Ihre/n Liebste/n mit ein: Surprise your loved one with a romantic trip along the Aare. Love, as they say, goes through the stomach, so we serve an aphrodisiac four-course menu and a sensual dessert.

Geniessen Sie ein leckeres Käsefondue mi: Enjoy a cheese fondue under the full moon. You glide quietly across Lake Biel until the full moon seems within reach, while our on-board kitchen serves everything that belongs to a good cheese fondue.
Auf der Ausstellung an Bord lernen Sie W: At the exhibition on board you meet winemakers from the region. The on-board kitchen serves local food such as the Treberwurst sausage speciality with a potato and leek gratin.
Installez-vous confortablement à bord po:
Settle in on board for a peaceful loop of more than two hours on Lake Neuchâtel, as the quiet winter shores unfold along the way.

To round it off, the brunch cruise offers a generous buffet that brings together savoury dishes (cold cuts, gravlax salmon, rösti) and sweet treats (pastries, pancakes, petits fours).

An exclusive experience, on only two dates in November.
Le 29 novembre, éclipsez-vous le temps d:
On 29 November, slip away for a lunchtime cruise from Neuchâtel.

Settle in and enjoy an authentic homemade choucroute (sauerkraut with meats), carefully prepared by our kitchen team. A generous, comforting stop, followed by a delicate iced nougat to savour while you look out at the shores.
Et si vous vous offriez une parenthèse u:
Treat yourself to a truly indulgent break.

On four dates in December, set off from Neuchâtel for a lunch break out of time. Settle in on board and glide along the snowy shores while you share an authentic three-course menu.

For young and old: a crisp salad, a creamy half-and-half fondue made with Gruyère from Sainte-Croix, and a meringue with double cream to finish.

Warmth, local flavours and relaxation guaranteed.
C’est le rendez-vous incontournable qui:
The event that warms the heart of winter. In January, Murten's old town dresses in light for an 11th edition true to its reputation: poetic, spectacular and immersive. As every year, the experience includes its trip across the lakes.

LNM invites you on board again for a crossing from one lake to the other. A calm moment away from the bustle, with a cheese fondue served on the way out in a cosy setting.

Then the medieval town comes into view. As you near the shore, the festival's large projections and art installations appear. You see the illuminated town from the deck, where the view is best, before joining the lively streets.
